spec_match.rationale: Enumerates all fourteen WebTransportConnectionStats members and all four WebTransportDatagramStats members in spec order with their normative meanings (including the bytesAcknowledged at-risk note and the pooled-stat markers), and fills the browser column only from a real resolved object.

interactive.rationale: Connect-and-snapshot flow with a user-editable endpoint fills both tables; returned/null/not-returned are distinguished per member.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises spec-vs-browser coverage including the documented Chromium omissions; the page delivers that framing and the reading guide.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes null (meaningful for the nullable estimatedSendRate) from absent, explains pooled-connection stripping, and handles no-WebTransport, method-missing, constructor-throw, timeout, and getStats rejection without ever guessing a value.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5120203192139776 (named as the source of the omission note) plus both dictionary anchors and the MSEdge demo.

conformance.rationale: Backed by the feature suite (6/6 flagged / 0/6 unflagged verified); the matrix itself is deliberately observational, matching the suite's local-failure-path scope.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Verified on headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright-driven CDP; no chrome-devtools-mcp here) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3, unflagged and behind WebTransportStats: the idle matrix renders all 18 spec rows, the connect attempt fails honestly (WebTransportError) leaving rows at 'needs a resolved stats object', zero page errors, no overflow. The filled matrix needs a reachable endpoint and remains unverified here.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts matrix-filled on success and the fallback/connect-failure branches; console prefixed [wt-stats:matrix].

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; returned/omitted colours (emerald-dark/rose) sit on paper at AA with the status word carrying the meaning.

accessibility.rationale: Tables have captions and scoped row/column headers, the state line is aria-live=polite, and cell states are words ('returned'/'not returned'), never colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both viewports screenshotted; the three-column tables fit at 360px with overflow-wrap, no page-level horizontal overflow.

openQuestions.title: Fill the matrix from a real Chrome 159 snapshot and record Chromium's actual member coverage
openQuestions.detail: From an unproxied network, resolve one snapshot and record which of the 14+4 members Chromium actually returns — in particular confirming the ChromeStatus claim that byte/packet totals are absent and whether estimatedSendRate is null or numeric on an idle echo connection. That recorded observation could then seed a follow-up assertion in a NEW suite (never editing this one).

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive data table narrow mobile no horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Caption + th scope row/col semantics; constrain wide tables to their own scroll container.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Both matrices use caption, scoped headers and .table-wrap; verified no page overflow at 360px DPR3.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status updates live region after button action
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce flow state through a polite live region; keep per-cell changes silent.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Only the state chip and summary output announce; the 18 cell updates render silently as a table refresh.

summary: The spec dictionary laid out in full against what this browser really returns, with the Chromium byte/packet omission presented as documented fact and every unfilled state labelled honestly; idle and failure flows verified on Chromium 153 flagged and unflagged.
